__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource used by all panels

panels.title: Redirects by type
panels.description: How many client redirects the redirector issues, split by request type (open-read, locate, …). The thick total line is the sum of all types.

panels.title: Top redirect destinations
panels.description: The 15 site gateways receiving the most client redirects right now. Lines are independent (not stacked). Membership can change over time as rates shift.

panels.title: All redirect destinations
panels.description: Full sortable list of destination hosts and current redirect rate. Use this for capacity / triage when the top-15 chart is not enough.

panels.title: OpenVerify redirects / s
panels.description: Redirect hops that entered the OpenVerify plugin. Compare with the AAA total above; they should be close when OpenVerify is on the open path.

panels.title: Verify failure rate
panels.description: Share of live probe opens that failed. Only counts hops that actually ran a probe (cache misses). Queue rejects are not included.

panels.title: Queue rejects / s
panels.description: Probes skipped because the verify queue was full or waited too long. These never ran a live open.

panels.title: Unhealthy sites
panels.description: How many sites currently score as unhealthy (EWMA quarantine). In observe mode clients are still redirected there; in enforce mode OpenVerify tries to skip them.

panels.title: Positive cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups that found a recent successful probe and skipped a new live open.

panels.title: Negative cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of lookups that found a recent failed probe. In observe mode the redirect is still returned; in enforce mode OpenVerify asks for another site.

panels.title: Rucio path share
panels.description: Of accepted opens, how many used a Rucio replica (vs falling through to cmsd). Near 0 when Rucio is off.

panels.title: Successful verify time
panels.description: Average time for a successful live probe. See the Verify time chart for success vs failure.

panels.title: Live verify outcomes
panels.description: Rate of live probe opens that succeeded or failed. Does not include cache hits or queue rejects.

panels.title: Cache lookups
panels.description: What the probe cache returned: hit_positive = reuse a good result; miss = run a live probe; hit_negative = remember a recent failure.

panels.title: Verify queue
panels.description: admitted = got a probe slot; queue_timeout / queue_full = skipped (no live open).

panels.title: Verify time (success vs failure)
panels.description: Average live-probe duration. Failures often sit near the verify timeout when sites hang.

panels.title: Redirect delay (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: How long OpenVerify holds the client redirect before accepting or retrying (queue wait + probe). Spikes often mean timeouts. Use the heatmap and Delay outcome filter to see which path dominates.

panels.title: Redirect delay distribution
panels.description: Full distribution of redirect hold time. Use the Delay outcome variable to focus on verify success/failure, queue rejects, cache hits, or avoided redirects. Does not include cmsd stall waits.

panels.title: cmsd stall waits
panels.description: How long cmsd asked the client to wait (SFS_STALL) before a destination was known. Separate from OpenVerify probe time.

panels.title: Rucio probe failures / s
panels.description: Live probes that failed against a Rucio-chosen replica. Filtered by Site and Error reason.

panels.title: Rucio replicas exhausted / s
panels.description: Rucio returned replicas, but none were accepted (probe fail, negative cache, quarantine, or already in tried=). OpenVerify then falls through to cmsd.

panels.title: cmsd recovered after exhaust / s
panels.description: Opens where every Rucio replica failed/was skipped, then cmsd openverify accepted. Absolute rate (pair with the ratio).

panels.title: cmsd recovery ratio after exhaust
panels.description: recovered / exhausted: fraction of Rucio-exhaust opens that cmsd then saved. Use with the absolute rate — a high ratio on tiny volume is less meaningful.

panels.title: Rucio probe failures by error
panels.description: Why Rucio-selected probes fail (timeout, auth, not found, …). Uses Site and Error reason filters.

panels.title: Rucio probe failures by site
panels.description: Which sites fail when OpenVerify tries their Rucio replica. Uses Site and Error reason filters.

panels.title: Rucio probe failures (selected time range)
panels.description: Total Rucio-path probe failures in the dashboard time range, by site and error. Sorted by count.

panels.title: cmsd probe failures / s
panels.description: Live probes that failed against a cmsd-chosen redirect. Filtered by Site and Error reason.

panels.title: cmsd retries exhausted / s
panels.description: Opens that used up the cmsd retry budget without a successful probe. Near 0 in observe mode (no retries).

panels.title: cmsd probe failures by error
panels.description: Why cmsd-selected probes fail. Uses Site and Error reason filters.

panels.title: cmsd probe failures by site
panels.description: Which sites fail when cmsd selected them. Uses Site and Error reason filters.

panels.title: cmsd probe failures (selected time range)
panels.description: Total cmsd-path probe failures in the dashboard time range, by site and error. Sorted by count.

panels.title: How opens were located (Rucio vs cmsd)
Rucio soft-fail / s
panels.description: Rucio list_replicas failed or returned no replicas (empty / auth / timeout / error). No Rucio probe was tried; OpenVerify went straight to cmsd.

panels.title: Rucio locate time
panels.description: Average time for one Rucio replica listing. This is catalog lookup time, not the site probe.

panels.title: cmsd locate time
panels.description: Average time for cmsd / base OFS to pick a redirect. Stall waits returned to the client are separate (see cmsd stall waits).

panels.title: Accepted opens by locate path
panels.description: Where the accepted redirect came from: rucio = a verified Rucio replica; cmsd = cmsd/OFS (including after Rucio soft-fail or exhaust).

panels.title: Rucio lookups
panels.description: ok = Rucio returned at least one replica; empty / auth_error / timeout / error = soft-fail to cmsd (no Rucio probe).

panels.title: Locate time (Rucio vs cmsd)
panels.description: Side-by-side comparison of catalog listing time (rucio) vs cmsd/OFS selection time. Site probe time is on the Verify time chart above.

panels.title: Rucio accepts by replica
panels.description: Which ordered Rucio replica was accepted after a successful probe. exhausted = every Rucio replica failed or was skipped, so OpenVerify fell through to cmsd.

panels.title: cmsd accepts by attempt
panels.description: Which cmsd redirect candidate was accepted after a successful probe. exhausted = cmsd retry budget used up without success (near 0 in observe mode).

panels.title: Rucio locate time distribution
panels.description: Distribution of Rucio list_replicas wall times. The mean alone can hide a long tail.

panels.title: cmsd locate time distribution
panels.description: Distribution of cmsd/OFS open-select wall times. Separate from site probe time and stall waits.

panels.title: cmsd host vs Rucio list (after exhaust)
panels.description: Only for opens that exhausted Rucio then succeeded on cmsd: overlap = cmsd host was already in the Rucio list (skipped/failed earlier); catalog_disagree = cmsd picked a host Rucio never listed. Diagnostic for catalog vs cmsd mismatch.

panels.title: Site health score (higher = worse)
panels.description: Rolling failure score per site (higher means more recent probe failures). Top 15 shown; the set can change as scores move.

panels.title: Site status (selected time range)
panels.description: Current health score and healthy flag, plus probe success/failure counts over the dashboard time range. healthy=0 can appear in observe mode without changing redirects.

panels.title: Bad redirects avoided / s
panels.description: Redirects skipped because the site was quarantined or in the negative cache (client gets tried= and another site). Near 0 in observe mode.

panels.title: Avoidance rate
panels.description: Avoided redirects as a share of OpenVerify-handled redirects. Near 0 in observe mode.

panels.title: Avoided redirects by reason
panels.description: quarantine = EWMA-unhealthy site skipped; negative_cache = recent failed probe remembered. Flat near 0 in observe mode.

title: CMS XRootD OpenVerify
description: Ops view of CMS global redirectors with OpenVerify: client AAA demand, probe health, Rucio vs cmsd errors, and locate path. Hover a panel title for a short explanation.
